div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Electronic health data originating from electronic health records.
Data concerning factors that influence health, including socioeconomic, environmental, and behavioural determinants.
Healthcare Needs, Resources and Financing Data
Aggregated data concerning healthcare needs, allocated resources, access to healthcare, healthcare expenditure, and financing.
Data concerning pathogens that affect human health.
Health-related administrative data, including claims and reimbursement information.
Human Genetic, Epigenomic and Genomic Data
Human genetic, epigenomic, and genomic data.
Human molecular data, including proteomic, transcriptomic, metabolomic, lipidomic, and comparable omics data.
Personal electronic health data generated automatically through medical devices.
Electronic health-related data generated through wellness applications.
Data concerning the professional status, specialization, and institution of healthcare professionals involved in treatment.
Data from medical registries and mortality registries.
Data from clinical trials, clinical studies, clinical investigations, and performance studies.
Other electronic health data generated through medical devices that are not represented by a more specific category.
Medicinal Product and Medical Device Registry Data
Data from registries for medicinal products and medical devices.
Research Cohort, Questionnaire and Survey Data
Data from research cohorts, questionnaires, and health-related surveys.
Electronic health data from biobanks and associated databases.
